name: Requests routed to what they ask for
purpose: Each request goes to the route a reader says it asks for: information, act, draft or clarify.
record: Forty-one invented requests (evaluation/route_a_request/build_cases.py): status and count questions that must not start work, requests for something to be done, bare cues that name a tracked milestone and so ask to move it, requests for text to be written in the reply, and requests that cannot be acted on yet. One number: the share routed to the labelled route, and the share per route.
disadvantages: The labels are one reader's judgment of what a request asks for; a request that asks two things is one case with one label. The model-free arms read the hub Planner, which reports no draft and no clarify, so they cannot be the measure of the classifier on those routes.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=the model-free arms and their rivals were recorded on the same cases] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end through the paid arm and is hand-read] > staged [sample=sample | real=yes | gate=competitive | max-age-days=90 | when=a call budget is set and the spend is approved] > whole [sample=full | real=yes | max-age-days=90 | when=the staged sample did not decide]
command: esoi run route_a_request --impl plan_derived; esoi run route_a_request --impl majority_floor; esoi run route_a_request --impl single_classifier --max-calls 41
